# AluCalc OS

> AluCalc OS (alucalculator.com) is an industrial-grade engineering operating system hosting 86 deterministic ISO, DIN, VDI, and ASME solvers, 3D parametric CAD workspace, and certified materials databases.

## Core Engineering Solvers

- [Bolted Joint Preload & Tightening Torque (VDI 2230)](https://www.alucalculator.com/bolt-torque): Deterministic tightening torque, clamp load, and thread stress calculations according to VDI 2230 Blatt 1 and ISO 898-1.
- [Rolling Bearings Rating Life (ISO 281)](https://www.alucalculator.com/bearings): ISO 281 L10 and L10h rating life, equivalent dynamic load, and lubrication life for ball and roller bearings.
- [Beam Deflection & Bending Stress](https://www.alucalculator.com/beam-deflection): Euler-Bernoulli beam deflection, shear force, bending moment diagrams, and section modulus for standard profiles.
- [Spur & Helical Gear Design (ISO 6336)](https://www.alucalculator.com/gears): Tooth root bending strength and surface contact safety factors according to ISO 6336 Method B.
- [Keyway Shaft Connection (DIN 6885)](https://www.alucalculator.com/keyway-connection): Surface pressure and shear stress verification for parallel key connections per DIN 6885/1.
- [Shaft Fatigue & Combined Stress (DIN 743)](https://www.alucalculator.com/shafts): Multi-stepped shaft safety factors against fatigue under combined torsion and bending loads.
- [Press Fits & Interference Fit (DIN 7190)](https://www.alucalculator.com/press-fit): Elastic and elastic-plastic contact pressure, transmissible torque, and hub yield safety per DIN 7190.
- [Fits & Tolerances ISO System (ISO 286)](https://www.alucalculator.com/fits): Fundamental deviations and tolerance classes for hole-basis and shaft-basis engineering systems.
- [Column Buckling (Euler / Johnson / AISC)](https://www.alucalculator.com/column-buckling): Critical buckling load and slenderness ratio across pinned, fixed, and free end conditions.
- [Fluid Dynamics & Pipe Friction](https://www.alucalculator.com/fluid-dynamics): Darcy-Weisbach head loss, Colebrook-White friction factor, and pump operating points per Crane TP-410.
- [Pneumatic & Hydraulic Cylinders](https://www.alucalculator.com/cylinders): Push/pull forces, fluid consumption, piston acceleration, and rod buckling safety.
- [Aluminum Profile Weight & Cost](https://www.alucalculator.com/aluminum): Mass, cross-section area, and extrusion estimation for standard 6000 and 7000 series aluminum profiles.

## CAD & 3D Engineering Workspaces

- [3D Parametric CAD / Design Studio](https://www.alucalculator.com/design-studio): Browser-native parametric 3D CAD modeling, mate assemblies, section inspection, and binary STL/DXF export.
- [2D CAD Drafting / AluCAD](https://www.alucalculator.com/cad-editor): Geometric constraint solver powered drafting workspace for precision DXF generation.
- [FEA Linear Static Simulation](https://www.alucalculator.com/fea): WebGL-accelerated 3-template finite element analysis for plates, brackets, and beams.

## Materials Databases & Technical Learning

- [Materials Database & Handbook](https://www.alucalculator.com/materials): Certified mechanical, physical, and thermal properties for 6061-T6, 6082-T6, 7075-T6, structural steels, and engineering plastics.
- [Engineering Academy](https://www.alucalculator.com/academy): 15 interactive engineering units covering VDI 2230, ISO 281, ISO 6336, and FEA static analysis.
- [Material Comparison Tool](https://www.alucalculator.com/compare): Side-by-side engineering comparison between standard alloy compositions and tempers.

## API & Machine-Readable Interfaces

- [MCP Server Card (SEP-1649)](https://www.alucalculator.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Official Model Context Protocol server capabilities and tool schemas.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Spec](https://www.alucalculator.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive multi-page markdown index and formulas for AI reasoning agents.
- [Structured API Endpoint](https://www.alucalculator.com/api/ai-agent): Programmatic JSON endpoints for automated agent queries.
